name: The Unique Games Theorem: a short self-contained proof and a compressed presentation of OpenAI's proof (papers, LaTeX sources and Lean check logs)
description: Two expository preprints on OpenAI's proof of the Unique Games Theorem (23 September 2026), with their standalone LaTeX sources, and the script and logs of a Comparator check of OpenAI's Lean 4 formalization of the source theorem. The short proof is self-contained apart from three earlier theorems stated as inputs and simplifies several steps of the source; the compressed presentation follows the source closely. Both were prepared with AI models and checked by separate AI reviewers; no human expert has reviewed them. The Lean check concerns OpenAI's formal development, not these papers.
runtimePlatform: Tectonic for the LaTeX sources; Python 3 for verify_manifest.py; Linux x86-64 for lean_check/ugc_lean_check.py
